documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported Q1 FY27 revenue from operations of ₹532 crore and profit after tax of ₹47 crore. The company faced raw material availability issues and geopolitical tensions in West Asia during the quarter, affecting its NPK-DAP capacity utilization. However, management expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover over last year and quarterly revenue of over ₹500 crore in the remaining quarters of FY27 as input supply normalizes. Management reported a strong start to FY27, with quarterly revenue growing by 34.58% YoY to Rs 532.3 crore and Profit After Tax increasing by 53.88% YoY to Rs 47.06 crore, driven by sustained capacity utilization and disciplined cost control. The phosphatic fertilizer sector is supported by favourable demand fundamentals, improving monsoons, higher Minimum Support Prices, and government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy framework.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover over last year as production smoothens in the remaining quarters.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: Management targets achieving a quarterly turnover of over ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: The company expects overall revenue growth of around 35% to 40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Yes, including the import and manufacturing we expect 40% growth should not be a big issue.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

demand_outlook.claim: National Kharif sowing declined by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares by the end of June due to rainfall being 40% below normal.
demand_outlook.quote: By the end of June, cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares, compared to 236.5 lakh hectares during the corresponding period last year.

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon revival in early July led to a recovery in sowing progress and accelerated fertilizer offtake.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable despite a slightly weaker monsoon forecast because water levels in reservoirs are higher.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating capacity expansion opportunities that have not yet been approved by the board.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company signed an agreement to procure green ammonia from a third-party capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: See this capacity of green ammonia is of a third-party capacity and we will buy this green ammonia with an arrangement from the Government of India, Department of Fertilizer one thing.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities include NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA at Meghnagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: NPK/DAP capacity was enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA alongside existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA under the National Green Hydrogen Mission.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA reached ₹89 crore, reflecting a 36% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: Quarterly EBITDA stood at ₹ 89 crore, reflecting a 36% year-on-year growth, supported by disciplined cost management, despite volatility in raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stands at approximately 7%–8% for trading operations and around 16% for manufacturing operations.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company passed on approximately 25% to 30% of input cost increases through higher subsidies and MRP revisions.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for FY26 decreased to 12.34% compared to 13.54% previously due to trading turnover impact.
margins_costs.quote: Our overall EBITDA margin, which was 13.54% has come down to 12.34%.

margins_costs.claim: From mid-February onwards, the global market witnessed firming input costs driven by supply-side constraints and higher freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

orders_capacity.claim: During Q1 FY27, the company recorded 43% capacity utilization in its NPK-DAP unit and 121% in its SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: The company expanded its total NPK-DAP capacity to 495,000 MT by adding 165,000 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: Manufacturing sales volumes for Q1 FY27 were 53,500 MT for NPK-DAP and 36,300 MT for SSP.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: Total installed capacity stands at 6.15 Lakh MTPA for fertilizers.
The company maintained healthy plant utilization with certain units operating above 100% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Maintained healthy utilization across NPK/DAP and SSP plants, with certain units operating above 100% capacity, reflecting strong demand and efficient plant operations

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed a 5-for-1 stock split, reducing the face value of equity shares from ₹10 to ₹2.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Finance costs increased from ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore and depreciation increased from ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore following plant commissioning.
capital_allocation.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The capacity expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts in West Asia created supply chain disruptions through critical shipping lanes like the Strait of Hormuz.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur prices rose significantly from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to near ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material availability served as the main operating challenge during the first quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The primary challenge during the first quarter was the availability of raw materials.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global input price volatility and supply uncertainties remain key monitors for the industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

risks_headwinds.claim: A timing mismatch occurred where domestic demand slowed in March while input costs increased, leading to cost pressure.
risks_headwinds.quote: This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to deliver an additional 30%–35% turnover growth over the previous year.
management_commitments.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets quarterly turnover exceeding ₹500 crore across the remaining quarters.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: The contracted green ammonia capacity is scheduled to commence supply in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to maintaining best asset utilization and efficient results across manufacturing units.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to the best utilization of our manufacturing facilities.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term stakeholder value.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for our stakeholders.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
